name: Elixirs for the Bladeleafs
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Our herb and alchemy shop is booming, but my husband spends so much time mixing potions that we never have time for each other.

Can you help us?

If you can bring me a supply of pre-made elixirs, then I would be happy to trade with you.  I have some rare herbs that you might find useful.
narrative.objectives: Bring 6 Elixirs of Lion's Strength and 2 Elixirs of Minor Defense to Syral Bladeleaf in Dolanaar.
narrative.offerRewardText:
These are nicely mixed. You take great care in your trade, adventurer, and that is important for an alchemist.

Here are your herbs, freshly gathered. May you use them well.
narrative.requestItemsText: Hello, adventurer. Do you have the elixirs to trade?
